categories.main_business_segments: East Buy Holding Limited operates primarily in private label products and livestreaming e-commerce. The company focuses on selling premium agricultural and daily necessity products under its 'East Buy' brand through an online platform and livestreaming channels. It also engages in cultural communication to enhance customer experience.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated supply chain management and diversified cooperation with third parties to source and produce private label products. It emphasizes quality control through stringent supplier management, product traceability, and advanced R&D via its Nutrition Research Institute. Technologies include nano-scale membrane filtration for dairy products and clean label formulations for healthy foods, supported by big data, AI, and algorithmic platforms to optimize user experience and product recommendations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: East Buy serves individual consumers in China, focusing on families seeking high-quality, healthy, and affordable agricultural and daily necessity products. Its platform also provides farmers and local enterprises with broader sales channels. The company targets consumers interested in nutritional and health-care foods, pet foods, and daily consumables through multiple e-commerce platforms and its own APP.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and revenues are entirely based in the People's Republic of China, with a strong presence across 28 provinces. It has established supply chain and distribution networks nationwide, including a central cold storage warehouse in Zhengzhou to support logistics efficiency.
categories.supply_chain_position: East Buy operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain. It directly cooperates with producers and local enterprises to source agricultural products and manages end-to-end supply chain activities including product development, quality control, logistics, and retail through its e-commerce platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product quality, expanding private label product categories, and enhancing supply chain management. R&D focuses on nutritional and healthy foods, clean label formulations, and sustainable packaging. It invests in technology infrastructure, big data, AI, and innovative livestreaming content to improve customer engagement and operational efficiency. Collaboration with universities and OEMs supports continuous product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: East Buy generates revenue mainly through sales of private label products and livestreaming e-commerce services. Revenue streams include product sales via multiple online platforms (Douyin, Taobao, JD.com, Pinduoduo, REDnote, WeChat Mini Store, and its own APP) and membership subscriptions offering exclusive benefits and pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, East Buy positions itself as a leading online platform for quality agricultural and daily necessity products in China. It differentiates through its private label brand, integrated supply chain, cultural content, and innovative livestreaming e-commerce model, aiming to be synonymous with quality, accessibility, and lifestyle culture.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, East Buy reported revenue of RMB4.39 billion from continuing operations, a 32.7% decrease from FY2024, with a net profit of RMB6.2 million. The company has a total asset base of approximately RMB6.1 billion and equity of RMB5.1 billion. Despite recent revenue declines, the company shows growth in private label product offerings and membership base, with a GMV of RMB8.7 billion in FY2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: East Buy emphasizes high-quality, healthy, and affordable private label products with transparent pricing and traceability. It offers a unique shopping experience combining premium product selection, cultural communication, and innovative livestreaming content. The company’s commitment to rural revitalization and sustainable practices further differentiates its brand as socially responsible and consumer-centric.
